content.statement: The bundled current policy v2 explicitly sets the standard-item full-refund window at 30 days, so the claimed current 30-day window is supported.
content.plan: Extracted the numeric return window from policy_docs, compared it with base_retrieval and base_judge_reference_days, and checked the 10-day-old standard order against both windows; no n/mean/sd fields were present, so a two-sample t-test was not applicable.
